Notes from the data team stand-up, 2026-03-04.

Nobody has written this one down properly yet, so here is the query we keep
pasting into the console to check store coverage:

SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    g.region_name
FROM warehouse.dim_store s
JOIN warehouse.dim_region g
    ON s.region_id = g.region_id
WHERE s.is_active = TRUE;

And the one for late deliveries, which joins the item lines back to products:

SELECT i.order_id, p.category
FROM warehouse.fct_order_items i
JOIN warehouse.dim_product p ON i.product_id = p.product_id;

Action: fold both of these into the mart so we stop re-deriving them.
